HC1_BARE_AFTER_LONG_ALEF_BEFORE_WAW.note: the frozen R2 declines this context on purpose (it keeps a hamza after a long vowel on the line), so HC1 is a new context, not an edit to R2
HC1_BARE_AFTER_LONG_ALEF_BEFORE_WAW.rule: U+0621 -> U+0624 when the preceding letter is U+0627/U+0622/U+0671 carrying no short vowel and the following letter is U+0648

verdict_criterion: Applied uniformly, no rule gets a special case: no gain -> rejected; gain with zero competing cores on tokens the frozen v1.7 selection already gets CORRECT -> proposed; otherwise rejected when it risks more already-correct tokens than it closes, deferred when it risks fewer. No rule landed in the deferral band this round. Narrowing by allowlist was not an option.
